subject: Short-run pilot: concession proposal & conversion rebate
messages:
From: Maya Ortega <maya@avery.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request for short extension + possible concessions

Hi Vivek,

Quick note from our side — the integration team hit a snag with the third-party vector connector and we need a little more runway to validate throughput at scale. Would Avery Labs be open to a 2–3 week extension of the time-boxed pilot?

If possible, two asks:
- A small credit or reduced unit rate for the extension window (we're not asking for a full refund)
- A conditional conversion incentive if we convert to committed capacity (something that offsets initial ramp costs)

We want to avoid changing the scope of the pilot — just more time and a modest concession so we can complete the perf/accuracy checks. Happy to discuss on a quick call.

Thanks,
Maya Ortega
Head of ML Ops, Avery Labs
maya@avery.ai

[attachment: integration-log-snippet.txt]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Maya Ortega <maya@avery.ai>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for short extension + possible concessions

Hi Maya — thanks for the heads up and for flagging the connector issue. Totally reasonable to give a little more time.

Proposed approach (quick summary):
- Extension: 3 additional weeks to the existing 6-week pilot (time-boxed).
- Pilot pricing during extension: 10% off our standard pilot rate for the extension weeks.
- Conversion rebate: if Avery signs a 12‑month committed plan within 60 days of pilot end, Redwood will issue a rebate equal to 20% of the pilot spend (applied as a credit to the first invoice). Rebate capped at $10,000.

I'll attach a short term sheet and a one‑page SOW addendum we can sign. If that structure looks OK, I'll loop in Sergio + RevOps for approvals and Legal for the addendum.

Proposed attachments: pilot-rebate-term.pdf, SOW-v1.docx

Would you prefer 3 weeks or should we do 2?

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com

--

Sergio / Laura — forwarding Maya's ask and the concession I proposed below. Two quick questions:

1) Is the 20% rebate with a $10k cap acceptable from a commercial standpoint?
2) Any RevOps / billing considerations for applying the rebate as a credit to month 1 invoice if they convert? Also, do we need an explicit DocuSign addendum to the SOW or is an e-mail confirmation sufficient?

Proposed commercial terms (recap):
- 3 week extension to pilot (time-boxed)
- 10% reduced rate during extension
- 20% rebate on pilot spend if they sign a 12‑month commit within 60 days, rebate capped at $10k

Maya is flexible on duration (2 vs 3 weeks) but wants clarity today so her team can schedule the final tests.

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request for short extension + possible concessions — need guidance

Thanks for the context, Vivek. High level: I support a concession here but propose tightening the risk on our side. My suggested counter:

- Extension: 3 weeks is OK, but make it explicit 'non-renewable' (single one-time extension).
- Extension pricing: 12% discount for the extension weeks (slightly better for us than 10%).
- Conversion rebate: 15% of pilot spend, capped at $8,000, payable as credit to first monthly invoice on conversion.
- Timebox for conversion incentive: customer must sign a 12‑month committed plan within 45 days of pilot end (shorten from 60).

Also: RevOps — please confirm billing flow. Legal — we should send a one-page addendum and use DocuSign (no email-only acceptance). Laura, can you prepare the addendum and stamp the cap/term? If we need to reserve any discount approval, I'll take it but prefer not to escalate.

If everyone agrees, I'll send the DocuSign and a one-page confirmation to Maya.

- Sergio
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com

Vivek — thanks for moving quickly and for the detail. The updated terms look reasonable. We accept: 3-week extension, 12% discount during extension, and the 15% rebate with $8k cap and 45 day conversion window.

Please send the one-page addendum + DocuSign link and we'll get procurement to sign this week. Also, can you confirm whether the extension weeks will be billed pro-rata or applied as a credit? We prefer a credit against the pilot invoice.

Appreciate the flexibility — this helps us finish the connector tests and proceed to the scale validation phase.

Best,
